g.text: Ideal straight prismatic elastic columns, specified rotational and lateral restraints, no sidesway except cantilever free end. Fixed–pin exact K≈0.699; conventional
rounded value0.7. Curved shapes are schematic mode sketches, especially mixed ends. Real frame restraint/effective length needs system analysis; residual stress and
